title: Fix PDF 'Open' button navigation on Gallery page

requirements.text: Fix the 'Open' button on the public gallery page (GalleryPage.tsx) so that clicking it successfully navigates the user to the PDF viewer page at /view/<shareId>. Investigate why navigation fails (e.g., broken route linking, missing shareId in card data, incorrect href/navigate call) and ensure each gallery card's 'Open' button correctly routes to the viewer for that PDF.

quotes: The pdfs don't open when you click 'open'

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking 'Open' on any PDF card in the gallery navigates the browser to /view/<shareId> for that PDF
The viewer page loads and renders the PDF content after clicking 'Open'
Navigation works for all gallery entries regardless of upload order
No JavaScript errors are thrown when clicking 'Open'

requirements.text: Verify that the ViewerPage.tsx correctly handles the shareId route parameter and that the chunked PDF retrieval flow (getPdfChunks → getPdfChunk → reassemble → iframe render) completes successfully when navigated to from the gallery. If the viewer page fails to load the PDF after navigation, fix the root cause (e.g., incorrect param extraction, actor not ready, premature fetch before actor is initialized).

quotes: The pdfs don't open when you click 'open'

acceptanceCriteria: The PDF viewer page successfully fetches and displays the PDF content when navigated to via the gallery 'Open' button
A loading progress indicator is shown while chunks are being fetched
An error message is shown if retrieval fails, rather than a blank or broken page

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
The gallery page must remain publicly accessible without authentication
nonGoals: Redesigning the gallery page layout or visual theme
Changes to the backend chunked upload or retrieval logic
